svg.title: OCAH top-level block diagram
svg.desc: The OCA Harness sits beside the user subsystem. The user subsystem reaches peer chiplets through AXI over UCIe (AoU) bridges and their die-to-die transceiver macros, and reaches a future System Management Network (SMN) through a clock-domain crossing. The SMN connects to the OCAH SMU, whose AXI4 crossbar has three initiators and three targets (SEP, SMC and the SMN), with no self-directed paths. Proposed ports, drawn apart from the crossbar, would connect a future safety monitor. DTP bridges external JTAG to the SMC AXI port and to the SEP and SMC TAPs. The SEP extension port gives the SEP unfettered access to the SMC, and a future safety bus links the safety monitor to the SEP and SMC. Hatched blocks with dashed outlines are future.
